# Chiplet_Based_Neuromorphic_Integration

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The use of modular chiplets—each implementing neural or synaptic functions—assembled via advanced packaging to form a neuromorphic system. Supports heterogeneous, scalable brain-inspired computing by mixing analog and digital cores, enabling efficient spike-based processing in distributed topologies.
